builtinTool.intro: This page displays the built-in tools currently available and their capabilities. Each category can be enabled or disabled as needed, with changes taking effect on the next chat turn.

categoryDesc.fs: Read, search, edit, delete and move files inside the project directory. Writes require Build mode; out-of-scope access needs approval. When disabled, the model no longer receives file tools.
categoryDesc.shell: Run shell commands inside the project directory. Dangerous commands are blocked; Build mode only. When disabled, the model can no longer run commands.
categoryDesc.browser: Open pages, read content and structure, click and fill forms, take screenshots and run diagnostics. When disabled, the model no longer receives browser tools.
categoryDesc.general: General, side-effect-free capabilities such as the current time.
categoryDesc.interaction: The Agent asks the user to pick among candidate options during a task. When disabled, the model asks directly in chat.

desc.readFile: Read a text file by line range inside the project directory
desc.listDir: List files and subdirectories of a directory
desc.glob: Find file paths matching a glob pattern
desc.search: Search file contents by regex and return line numbers
desc.writeFile: Create or overwrite a file, creating parent directories
desc.editFile: Replace specified text in a file with new text
desc.deleteFile: Permanently delete a file; directories require explicit recursion and cannot be undone
desc.moveFile: Move or rename a file or directory; parent directories are created automatically
desc.command: Run a shell command inside the project directory and return output (Build mode only)
desc.openBrowser: Open a page or search keywords in the Browser panel
desc.readBrowser: Read the title, URL and content of the current browser tab
desc.snapshotBrowser: List interactive elements with stable refs for click and fill
desc.clickBrowser: Click a page element, including right-click and repeated clicks (Build mode only)
desc.fillBrowser: Fill inputs, selects and checkboxes, optionally submitting the form (Build mode only)
desc.hoverBrowser: Hover over an element to reveal hover menus or tooltips
desc.pressBrowser: Send a key to the focused or specified element, such as Enter, Tab or Escape
desc.selectBrowser: Select a dropdown option by value or visible text
desc.scrollBrowser: Scroll the page: up / down / top / bottom
desc.waitBrowser: Wait for a selector, page text or URL condition
desc.screenshotBrowser: Capture the visible page for layout and visual verification
desc.inspectBrowser: Read console warnings/errors and failed page loads
desc.browserTabs: List, switch or close browser tabs
desc.time: Get the current local date and time, with an optional IANA timezone
desc.askUser: Let the user pick among 2-20 candidate options, with single or multiple selection and an "Other" free-form entry
